name: auralmind-fastmcp-server
description: Render-ready AuralMind MCP server (streamable HTTP, ChatGPT Developer Mode compatible)

AURALMIND_JOBS_DIR.description: Working directory for uploaded and rendered audio jobs (ephemeral on Heroku by default)

AURALMIND_SCRIPT_PATH.description: Path to the AuralMind mastering script file

AURALMIND_DEFAULT_PRESET.description: Default preset used when none is provided

MAX_JSON_MB.description: JSON body cap for base64 uploads via MCP tools

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Public base URL for generated output links (e.g. https://chatgpt-music.onrender.com)

LINK_BANK_FILE.description: Render secret file path containing one URL per line

LINK_BANK_FALLBACK.description: Local fallback file path for URL list when secret file is absent

DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_S.description: Per-download read timeout for remote audio fetches
